description:
During any opponent's turn, activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
